assumptions.choice: When the required second sentiment data series is absent, use a NaN-valued line so sentiment comparisons cannot generate entries; if a second series is supplied, read its close line as the single sentiment value per aligned bar.
assumptions.reason: The fixed harness supplies only one OHLCV data feed and no sentiment column, so the stated separate sentiment series is unavailable and must not be fabricated from price or volume.
The position-size formula requires base_size but the specification does not assign it a value.

assumptions.choice: Capture ATR when the entry signal submits the market order, then place the stop from the completed entry order's executed price.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines the stop relative to entry_price but does not state which bar's ATR to use when a market order fills on a later bar.
